name: NIFTY monthly DN strangle: WITH 40pct gap repair

spec.name: NIFTY monthly DN strangle: WITH 40pct gap repair

notes: Testing the hypothesis that the 40% gap repair needs RUNWAY to be right: the source strategy is a BANKNIFTY MONTHLY cycle with ~25 days to expiry, and on the 2-day NIFTY weekly hold (runs 021 vs 023-025) adjusting destroyed the edge monotonically. This is the treatment arm of a controlled pair: identical entry and target to the control, the only difference is the repair. ENTRY RULE: the source's 'skip the first two days, deploy on the 3rd' expressed as a days-to-expiry band (dte 5..26) plus a 20-session hold, which yields one position per monthly cycle. That rule became expressible only after the 21 Aug 2026 fix. RULES 3-5 EXPRESSED DIRECTLY: 40% premium-gap roll, no-crossover stop at the straddle, iron-fly wings at the straddle breakevens. SUBSTITUTIONS: support/resistance -> 20-delta; '11:00-13:50' -> fixed 11:00; the 40% threshold is measured on the credit AT ENTRY, the literal reading of the source. SAMPLE IS THIN: ~20 trades. Tests the mechanism, not the edge. Treatment arm, pairs with control run 027.
